acceptance.text: When a member shares a note and picks an expiry time, the system shall store that time on the new link.
When someone opens a link after its expiry time, the system shall show that the link has expired and shall not return the note.
While a link has no expiry time, the system shall keep it valid until it is revoked or its note is deleted.
If the chosen expiry time is not in the future, the system shall refuse to create the link.
While a link is revoked or expired, the system shall not return its note.
When the weekly digest is built, the system shall list the owner's links that expire within 7 days.
If a link was created before this change, the system shall treat it as having no expiry time.
When an editor revokes a link, the system shall stop returning its note, as it does today.
When the digest is built for a week with no changed note, the system shall send nothing.
If a viewer tries to create a link, the system shall refuse, as it does today.
